title: He Flew To Ireland By "Accident" And Became A Hero ✈️
caption:
A pilot "accidentally" flew across the Atlantic ✈️
Wait for the ending 👀

True story. In 1938 Douglas Corrigan took off from New York with a flight plan for California and landed in Dublin 28 hours later. He blamed his compass. Officials had refused his request to fly to Ireland, and almost nobody believed him. He never admitted it.
Honest mistake or genius excuse? 👇
first_comment: He even endorsed a watch that ran backwards. Honest mistake or the best excuse ever? ⌚👇
